headline: Mexico ends a 40-year knockout drought, beats Ecuador to advance in World Cup
context: Mexico lost seven consecutive times at that same stage from 1994 to 2018 and didn't advance past the group stage in 2022. Now, the 40-year wait is over.

sources.name: NPR
